lines.text: Keep walking. He is the one you want.

npcs.bio: Plate, and nothing out here is made of plate.

npcs.name: Rukaya

lines.text: I walked down for this. Eleven years and I have never walked down for anything.

npcs.bio: Eleven years at the far end of the worst road on the planet. Keeps the book, the water and a very short list of people whose word she will take.

npcs.name: Jamil

lines.text: Any chance you are looking for a job? We got great ICECREAM here, super fun to make.

topics.label: how do I make ICECREAM?
replies: Apron on. The ticket comes up on the rail and you build what it says.
Six things, and the sixth one is hurry.
The ticket tells you cup or cone. Tap the one it says — get that wrong and nothing after it counts for much.
Then the nozzle. Chocolate, swirl, vanilla, and the ringed one is the one they ordered.
Then you PULL it. Press under the nozzle and go round, and round, and keep the same circle — small is two turns, medium three, large four and a half. Wobble and it comes out looking like a rockfall.
Sauce across the whole of it, topping across the whole of it, and then move. It is forty degrees out that door. It starts melting the moment it leaves the machine.

topics.label: How did you get into the icecream business?
replies: Everybody asks it like that. Like it is a strange thing to do here.
Kufa is the only town on this planet with water UNDER it. Not a river, not rain — a whole cold body of it down in the rock, and every argument this town has ever had is about who gets a share.
My father hauled it. Forty years, bucket by bucket, and he sold it for what a bucket of water is worth, which is nothing, because everyone has one.
So I freeze it. Same water. Two coins.
They queue. For their own water. I love this town.

npcs.bio: Freezes the one thing this planet has and sells it back in a cone. Has been one pair of hands short since the spring.

npcs.name: Jibril

lines.text: Do not stand behind me at the table. I lose when people stand behind me.

topics.label: What is the road like just now?
replies: Which one. West is a road. North is a rumour.
The far leg past the milestone — that is where the two went. I have driven it eleven times and eleven times I have come back, and I could not tell you why me and not them.
Ghazi pays by the wagon. He does not pay by the driver.

topics.label: Why drink here and not at home?
replies: Because my house is forty degrees and this room is not.
Stone walls, no windows on the sun side, and Nasrin puts the jars in the cellar. That is the whole trick. There is nothing magic in it.
Half this town thinks she keeps ice down there. She keeps a hole in the ground and a lot of patience.

topics.label: Any good on that table?
replies: I have lost eleven in a row to a fox who is not looking at the ball.
Go on. Somebody should take it off her.

topics.label: Nothing.
replies: Right you are.

npcs.bio: Nineteen crossings and counting. Drinks here between legs, because the tavern is the only room in Kufa that is not warm.

npcs.name: Dara

lines.text: Busy today.
Caravan is due. It is always busy the day a caravan is due.

npcs.bio: Sells water by the cup at the crossing and has never once run out.

npcs.name: Sabi

lines.text: What is west of here?
Bazaar, then road, then more road. Do not walk it at dusk.

npcs.bio: Walks the square twice a day out of habit rather than need.

npcs.name: Halim

lines.text: Nice square.
It is brass and it is brown and it is ours. You get used to the glare.

npcs.bio: Waiting on a brother who is two caravans late.

npcs.name: Yara

lines.text: Anything worth seeing?
The oasis, south. Only green thing for a day's walk.

npcs.bio: Knows every stall in the bazaar and what each of them overcharges for.

npcs.name: Nadir

lines.text: Hello.
Keep to the shade side. That is all the advice anyone here gives free.

npcs.bio: Was a runner for the barracks. Retired, and still walks like one.

npcs.name: Bexi

lines.text: Who runs the town?
The castle, up the north road. The barracks, mostly, if you are honest.

npcs.bio: Came in on a caravan eleven years ago and never got back on one.

lines.text: Welcome to Kufa, Steward.
Your ship is fuelled and berthed behind you. The teleporter at the end of the gantry puts you down on the crest pad in town.

topics.label: How do I get back to space?
replies: Walk back to your ship and board her. She will take you up to orbit.
